ex.s: His father frequently amused the boy with a tablet computer which was loaded with colorful pictures that come alive when you poke them.
ex.t: 他的父亲经常用平板电脑逗他开心，平板电脑上加载着彩色图片，一戳就会动。

ex.s: But I will make sure my 2-year-old grandson sees it on his tablet.
ex.t: 但我会确保我两岁的孙子在他的平板电脑上看到它。

ex.s: He took it for a tablet computer.
ex.t: 他把它当成了平板电脑。

ex.s: And MP3 players, smart phones, and LCD TVs entered homes in 2002, before tablets and e-readers showed up in 2007.
ex.t: MP3播放器、智能手机和液晶电视在2002年进入家庭，之后平板电脑和电子阅读器在2007年出现。

ex.s: They found that more on-demand entertainment viewing on tablets instead of TVs and desktop computers could cut energy consumption by 44%.
ex.t: 他们发现，更多在平板电脑上而不是电视和台式电脑上进行按需娱乐观看可以将能耗降低44%。

ex.s: Most young people preferred reading e-books on tablets.
ex.t: 大多数年轻人更喜欢在平板电脑上阅读电子书。

ex.s: Indeed, nothing seems to upset the elderly so much as the ever-present smartphone, along with its cousins the laptop, the tablet and the PC.
ex.t: 的确，似乎没有什么比无处不在的智能手机，以及它的“近亲”笔记本电脑、平板电脑和个人电脑，更让老年人心烦的了。

ex.s: Across the world, centres for the elderly report that their most popular classes are in the use of smartphones and tablets.
ex.t: 在世界各地，老年中心报告说，最受欢迎的课程是智能手机和平板电脑的使用。

ex.s: Being able to use a computer, smartphone or tablet makes this easier to do, and can open the door to interesting hobbies.
ex.t: 能够使用电脑、智能手机或平板电脑让这件事更容易做到，并能开启有趣爱好的大门。

ex.s: The schools have tablets and touchscreens instead of books and blackboards in the classrooms.
ex.t: 这些学校的教室里用的是平板电脑和触摸屏，而不是书本和黑板。

defs.def: an amount of another substance in a small round solid piece 丸

ex.s: The team’s data only went up to 2007, but the researchers also explored what would happen if consumers replaced old products with new electronics that serve more than one function, such as a tablet for word processing and TV viewing.
ex.t: 团队的数据只统计到2007年，但研究人员还探讨了如果消费者用具有多种功能的新电子产品替代旧产品会发生什么，例如用于文字处理和看电视的平板电脑。

a piece of soap 一块肥皂
a number of pieces of paper for writing or drawing on, that are fastened together at one edge 便笺本；拍纸簿
